skills.description_zh: Office-agent skill inventory & health check. Scans any skills directory, measures size and context-token footprint, detects duplicates, and classifies skills into used / protected / closeable / manual-review buckets. Reverse-dependency scanning locks skills referenced by automations, hooks or plugins. Read-only by default: two disclosed, consent-gated writes — `--overrides --apply --yes` (programmatic close on platforms like WorkBuddy; dry-run without --yes) and `--set-lang` (saves language preference to ~/.workbuddy/skill-inventory.json) — plus one backup artifact (timestamped settings.json.bak.<ts>) created before the close write. No network, no subprocesses. English docs: SKILL.en.md. 办公型 Agent 技能库盘点与效能体检。扫描任意技能目录，统计数量/体积/上下文 token 占用，识别重复技能，按「在用/受保护/可关闭/需人工确认」四档给出建议；反向依赖扫描锁定被自动化/Hook/插件引用的技能。默认只读，两处写路径均需授权：`--overrides --apply --yes`（缺 --yes 仅预览）与 `--set-lang`（写语言偏好）。无网络、无子进程。
